title: Blueberry Bliss Balls
summary: Soft, naturally sweet blueberry bliss balls made with wholesome ingredients and no baking required. A healthy snack for the whole family.
ingredients: 1 cup (120g) frozen blueberries ( no need to thaw)
steps: Add all ingredients to a food processor. Process until the mixture becomes sticky and holds together when pressed between your fingers.
Using a small cookie scoop or spoon, portion the mixture and roll into balls.
If desired, roll the balls in additional shredded coconut.
